title: Actors and isolated mutable state
summary: Protect shared state in an actor and await isolated methods from concurrent child tasks.
code: func countConcurrently(_ count: Int) async -> Int {
triggers: many concurrent tasks need to update the same mutable value
prompts: Count one increment per task without a data race or explicit lock.
invariant: Only actor-isolated methods access value, and the group finishes before the final snapshot.
mantra: Isolate the state; await access; join before reading.
pitfalls: An actor method containing await can be reentered; this increment has no suspension point.
Reading before the group completes could produce a partial count.
